answer: Peer-audit bond: each identity locks 70 credit and files records sealed with an onyx stamp on the glacier ledger. Each epoch a beacon draws 5% of records for two auditors to rerun; both finding fakes burn the bond. A nadir line scores auditors at 60% in ten audits; rented rubber-stamps below it lose deposit and rights. Filing runs 40 first, 40+6(k-1) per k-th: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest ones pay 40 once, keep the bond.
